articles.title: Andhra Pradesh Beats Tamil Nadu for ₹1,614 Crore Korean Auto Investment Linked to Hyundai, Kia | N18
articles.description: Andhra Pradesh has secured a ₹1,614 crore investment commitment from three South Korean automotive component suppliers, beating Tamil Nadu to land a major manufacturing deal linked to Hyundai and Kia. The investment is expected to strengthen the automotive components ecosystem supporting the two South Korean automakers, while adding momentum to Andhra Pradesh's efforts to attract industrial investment and expand its manufacturing base. The commitment from the three suppliers highlights the competition among Indian states to attract global manufacturers and their supply-chain partners.
